def material_to_texture(material):
    """
    Convert a trimesh.visual.texture.Material object into
    a pyglet- compatible texture object.

    Parameters
    --------------
    material : trimesh.visual.texture.Material
      Material to be converted

    Returns
    ---------------
    texture : pyglet.image.Texture
      Texture loaded into pyglet form
    """
    from PIL import Image
    from trimesh.visual.texture import Material
    from trimesh.util import iofunc

    if isinstance(material, Material):
        # load the image
        image = Image.open(iofunc(material.image_data))
        # create a texture
        texture = pyglet.image.ImageData(image.size[0],
                                         image.size[1],
                                         'RGBA',
                                         image.tobytes())
        # create a texture object
        texture = pyglet.image.Texture.create_for_image(texture)
    else:
        raise ValueError('material must be a trimesh.visual.texture.Material')

    return texture

    """
    from trimesh.visual.texture import Material
    from trimesh.util import iofunc

    if isinstance(material, Material):
        # load the image
        image = Image.open(iofunc(material.image_data))
        # create a texture
        texture = pyglet.image.ImageData(image.size[0],
                                         image.size[1],
                                         'RGBA',
                                         image.tobytes())
        # create a texture object
        texture = pyglet.image.Texture.create_for_image(texture)
